coverage_limits: I read only the third-page crops. I did not open the full-page originals (sN.jpg) to settle low-certainty points; I did not read the independent blind JSON files.
Findings and corrections are given only where letters or punctuation were visibly legible. Dagesh, meteg and accents in small or blurred type are listed as unresolved, not certified.
Running heads and folios were seen but not compared, because the dossier does not model them.
Human decisions #3 (אִהֵל) and #4 (qadosh accents/paseq) were accepted without reopening; nothing I saw contradicts them.

Source acceptance is NOT claimed for s104, s106 or s108 while their findings and unresolved items stay open. s105 is clean apart from the missing sic/corr marker. s107 and s109 are clean, though s107 has one noted artefact.
